scripts: register namespace (wknd) https://site.wknd/1.0
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content/dam/wknd
create path (nt:unstructured) /content/dam/wknd/jcr:content

set properties on /content/dam/wknd/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/wknd
  set jcr:title{String} to "WKND Sites Project"
end
create group wknd-authors with path /home/groups/wknd
create group wknd-publishers with path /home/groups/wknd
create group wknd-administrators with path /home/groups/wknd

set ACL for wknd-authors
  allow jcr:read,jcr:modifyProperties,jcr:addChildNodes,jcr:removeNode on /content/wknd
end

set ACL for wknd-authors
  allow jcr:read,jcr:addChildNodes,jcr:modifyProperties on /content/dam/wknd
end

set ACL for wknd-publishers
  allow jcr:read,rep:write on /content/wknd
end

set ACL for wknd-publishers
  allow jcr:read on /content/dam/wknd
end

set ACL for wknd-administrators
  allow jcr:all on /content/wknd
end

set ACL for wknd-administrators
  allow jcr:all on /content/dam/wknd
end

set ACL for wknd-administrators
  allow jcr:all on /conf/wknd
end
create user Tom with path /home/users/wknd with password 123456
create user Jerry with path /home/users/wknd with password 123456
create user Timon with path /home/users/wknd with password 123456
create user Pumba with path /home/users/wknd with password 123456
create user Mario with path /home/users/wknd with password 123456
create user Luigi with path /home/users/wknd with password 123456
add Tom to group wknd-authors
add Jerry to group wknd-authors
add Timon to group wknd-publishers
add Pumba to group wknd-publishers
add Mario to group wknd-administrators
add Luigi to group wknd-administrators
